subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this coordinated 14-action upgrade after exact-head checks and representative credentialed workflow validation, or split the Codex, release, and security-sensitive pins into separately proven updates?
rationale: The patch changes third-party code executing inside workflows with credentials, publishing authority, and security-report access; accepting the residual operational and supply-chain boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Validate Then Merge
options.body: Keep the grouped immutable-pin update and merge after exact-head checks plus representative Codex-agent, token-minting, CodeQL/SARIF, and container-release validation.

options.title: Split Sensitive Pins
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing actions from routine setup, labeler, and stale updates so each sensitive group receives narrower proof.

options.title: Pause The Group
options.body: Defer this grouped PR and allow smaller Dependabot updates if representative validation is disproportionate to its maintenance value.

recommendation.title: Validate Then Merge
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped immutable-pin update and merge after exact-head checks plus representative Codex-agent, token-minting, CodeQL/SARIF, and container-release validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The live timeline records direct involvement, and this decision crosses repository-wide security and release automation.
